answer: AI-agent economies deter Sybil attacks by using a hardware Trusted Platform Module as a cryptographic anchor for each identity. A verifier sends a nonce that the chip signs alongside firmware state using a non-exportable endorsement key. Because private keys cannot be cloned in software, attackers must buy dedicated silicon, even a chip the size of a pearl, per persona. However, trust rests on vendor PKI; even if a security summit tightens audits, a leaked root key enables forged identities.
